name: Should I climb on my roof to take damage photos?

mainEntity.name: Should I climb on my roof to take damage photos?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is generally not recommended to climb on your roof yourself for photos, especially if you suspect significant damage, as it can be unsafe. Instead, use a ladder to get photos from the edge of the roof, use a drone if available, or take photos from the ground with a zoom lens. Our team at Discounted Roofing Co. can perform a professional roof inspection and provide detailed photo documentation safely as part of our service.
acceptedAnswer.description: Avoid climbing your roof due to safety risks; use a ladder from the edge, a drone, or a zoom lens from the ground. Professionals can also provide safe documentation.
